source_truth: checked-in sema, lowering, runtime, fixture, and test contracts only

consumed_values.rule: consumed retainable values transfer ownership at consumed call boundaries and remain unavailable until reassigned

borrowed_references.rule: borrowed references are non-owning and cannot escape through unproven parameters, escaping blocks, or untied borrowed returns

arc_boundary_lowering.rule: supported ARC boundaries lower through private retain, release, autorelease, weak, autoreleasepool, and block helper contracts
arc_boundary_lowering.non_goal: no public ARC runtime ABI widening, generalized local lifetime inference, or cross-module ARC optimization

runtime_public_api.rule: public runtime result and string contracts expose runtime-owned borrowed data with fail-closed ownership diagnostics

diagnostic_contracts.meaning: unsupported ownership-qualified executable source remains rejected
borrowed pointer passed to parameter not proven non-escaping
borrowed pointer captured by escaping block
borrowed return lacks valid owner parameter
borrowed pointer cannot satisfy consumed parameter
ownership value used after being consumed

required_tokens: ownership value used after being consumed

fail_closed_drift_checks: every source_record path must be checked in source truth, not tmp or generated report output
every required token must remain present in its source path
diagnostic codes in flow contracts must be represented in diagnostic_contracts
unsupported ARC and ownership automation must remain explicit non-goals
